sources.title: Transnet National Ports Authority Port Statistics
sources.source_statement: The page states that cargo statistics are based on actual cargo dues invoiced and displays monthly series through 2026-09 at the retrieval snapshot.
permitted_use: Identify official monthly port-statistics files for a future exact data intake
After downloading and pinning a file, calculate a source-scoped historical port cargo series
prohibited_inference: Do not infer TEU throughput from unlabeled summary columns
Do not infer port/terminal capacity from invoiced cargo statistics
Do not infer rail corridor throughput from port cargo alone
required_qualification: Record artifact digest, filename, units, definitions, coverage, revisions and rights
Cross-check totals against annual publications and do not silently interpolate missing months

sources.title: KZN Logistics Hub Programme and Port of Durban Master Plan
sources.source_statement: Transnet page describes 33 projects across Durban and Richards Bay masterplans, an estimated programme investment above R154 billion, Durban current container capacity of 2.9 million TEUs and planned future capacity of 11.4 million TEUs.
permitted_use: Record official planning claims with their stated units and source date/retrieval date
Construct alternative hypotheses for capacity transition scenarios
prohibited_inference: Do not treat planned capacity as operating capacity
Do not treat capacity as observed throughput, berth productivity or guaranteed delivery
Do not infer that every planned project is funded, permitted, commissioned or complete
required_qualification: Confirm latest revision and project-level status
Identify terminal boundary and TEU basis

sources.title: Minister of Transport keynote at Africa Rail Convention
sources.publisher: South African Department of Transport / Government of South Africa
sources.source_statement: The speech reports approval of the first 11 private Train Operating Companies for network access on 2026-03-13, says operations are expected to commence on 2027-04-01, and reports planned combined freight volumes up to 24 million tonnes per annum.
permitted_use: Represent the approval as an official policy milestone
Represent 2027 start date and 24 million tonnes/year as a dated plan/expectation in scenario branches
prohibited_inference: Do not mark private TOC service as operational before separately verified observed commencement
Do not treat planned 24 Mt/year as available corridor capacity or actual freight moved
Do not assume all allocated slots, routes or commodity handling are interchangeable
required_qualification: Verify network statement, access contracts, train paths, capacity allocation, route segments and first observed operations
Record operator, commodity, start date and reporting period

sources.title: South Africa Climate Change Coastal Adaptation Response Plan launch statement
sources.publisher: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment / Government of South Africa
sources.source_statement: Launch statement describes five components (ecosystems, communities, infrastructure, livelihoods, governance), 21 measurable response outcomes, more than 150 interventions, and stakeholder consultation during 2023–2024.
permitted_use: Define policy-aligned evidence domains and data-gap questions for coastal adaptation
prohibited_inference: Do not infer a specific Durban asset's exposure or approved intervention from the national launch statement
Do not treat announcement as proof of completed local implementation
required_qualification: Obtain the complete plan and relevant KZN/local implementation plans
Bind intervention, geography, accountable authority, status, budget and monitoring evidence

sources.title: National Water Resource Strategy Third Edition
sources.publisher: South African Department of Water and Sanitation
sources.source_statement: NWRS-3 sets national directions for sustainable/equitable water management, climate adaptation, water quality, ecological infrastructure and water-sector governance.
permitted_use: Define mandatory questions for catchment evidence, rights, water quality, environmental flows and ecological infrastructure
prohibited_inference: Do not infer site-specific allocable surplus, water-use authorization, environmental reserve or transfer feasibility from the national strategy alone
required_qualification: Obtain applicable catchment/Water Management Area data, current water balances, Reserve/flow determinations, licensed uses and competent-authority evidence

sources.title: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System: Final Network Statement and Rail Access Tariffs 2024/2025
sources.publisher: South African Department of Transport / Government of South Africa
sources.source_statement: Official government notice links a final network statement and rail access tariffs for 2024/2025.
permitted_use: Historical/dated policy and network-statement reference after attachment review
prohibited_inference: Do not treat 2024/2025 statement or tariff as current 2026/2027 access conditions
Do not use a network statement without validating superseding notices, route restrictions and effective dates
required_qualification: Retrieve exact attachment bytes and digest
Check current network statement, access tariffs, amendments and effective dates
Validate segment-level capacity, restrictions and operating conditions
